answer: That removes the incentive to provoke slashes and makes the penalty a real loss of supply rather than a transfer. Because the wander burn is recorded at the ember settlement, the grove audit shows the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. 95% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. A 485 account operation therefore ties up 40 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
